about: Raglan tee (MODELQ7 2026-11-23, coordinator; card 46987): Tripo model raglan-tee-textured.glb (shape only), coloured from raglan-tee-parts.glb by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs. Printed through the made tee's pattern. Shown by the flag raglanTee on Touch > 'Touch tee' and the new 'Raglan tee' tiles (after each 'Raglan long-sleeve' tile). The raglan sleeves (neck to cuff) take the Left / Right sleeve colour areas; the round neck band the Collar colour. Look from the card: rose body, deep raspberry sleeves, cuffs and neck band; our marks only.
